title: DURING the flood

items.question: Floodwater is rising around you. What should you do first?
You see a fallen electric wire in the water. What do you do?
choices: Stay far away and go around

items.question: How do you go up to a higher floor during a flood?
Why is walking through floodwater dangerous?
choices: It can hide open manholes and debris

items.question: Your younger sibling is with you. What should you do?
choices: Keep them with you and move together

items.question: Fast-moving water can knock a person down even when it is shallow.
It is safe to play in floodwater.
You should stay away from electric posts and wires during a flood.
Elevators are the safest way to go up during a flood.
Listening to official advisories helps you know what to do next.

source: PLACEHOLDER: general flood-safety guidance. The research team will supply the real items and references.
